name: Erlengrund
beschreibung: Erlengrund is one of the ten camp meadows of the Tiroler Pfadfinderzentrum (TPZ) Igls, which is run by the regional association of Tyrolean Scouts and Girl Scouts. It is located in Igls, south of Innsbruck, in the area of the old Olympic bobsleigh run. Group campsites and camp grounds are available on the site; primarily scout and youth groups, clubs and events are accommodated. The outdoor sanitary facilities include 12 sinks for washing dishes, 8 showers and 4 separate washrooms. Lockable refrigerators, beer table sets, fire bowls and construction timber can be rented; on two meadows there is a fire pit by arrangement. An overnight stay at the camp ground costs 7 euros per person per night including sanitary facilities, construction timber, grill barrel and waste stand. Reservations are made via the TPZ booking form.
kurzbeschreibung: Camp meadow Erlengrund of the Tiroler Pfadfinderzentrum Igls near Innsbruck – campsite and camp ground for scout, youth and club groups.
